Bp Plc who had been investing in Facebook Inc A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $383.36 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:FB) has declined 21.26% since December 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.26% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Verizon Communications In (NYSE:VZ) by 85,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 602,000 shares, and has risen its stake in Svb Financial Group (NASDAQ:SIVB).
